risk_note: F1-08an. apps/admin only (pages/withdrawals, texts/withdrawals.ts). Adds 批量自动打款: one POST /admin/v1/payout-batches with Idempotency-Key and X-Step-Up-Token after a totp step-up, per-item left reasons and whole-batch refusals shown verbatim, result-unknown locks input and key (retry with the same key and body only, no automatic resend). 一键组批 is front-end only (no write). Tab counts are page_size=1 reads of listAdminWithdrawals showing total. No amounts are computed on the client. Frozen-test changes only widen entry lists to exactly the landed entries, add strict count-read assertions beside unchanged list-read expectations, and were checked by the orchestrator (D10-2172 / 2173 / 2179).
